gse244832.allowed_use: External-development frozen RNA-query cell-state robustness and donor-by-cell-state ATAC profile diagnostics only. Different RNA and ATAC aliquots are never row-paired.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 rows, query clustering, covariate categories, labels, ATAC, latent-scale moments, feature selection, early stopping, heads, projection, or calibration may enter a model scored on GSE244832.

gse289173.allowed_use: Conditional one-time RNA-only cell-state mapping through frozen raw-count alignment, RNA encoder, training-frozen latent scaling, and the locked common head. No ATAC translation is needed or confirmable.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized raw RNA only after selection lock; no labels, eQTL or ieQTL outcomes, ATAC object, query clustering, covariate fitting, norm-factor updates, diffusion adaptation, head fitting, projection, or calibration before prediction hashes are committed.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-training same-nucleus RNA-ATAC autoencoder and diffusion fitting, followed by donor-held RNA-only cell mapping and direct ATAC profile evaluation with held ATAC evaluator-only.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors define genes, peaks, binary accessibility, raw-count representation, autoencoder, latent scales, diffusion state, sampler selection, early stopping, heads, profile normalization, or calibration.

local_model_roster.common_lane: frozen layer-normalized RNA MLP latent plus identical common head
local_model_roster.native_lane: unconditional conditional-DDPM RNA-to-ATAC translation through a direct tensor adapter; released translation script excluded
local_model_roster.profile_lane: sigmoid Bernoulli peak probabilities, with any multinomial row normalization frozen prospectively

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; never identity-paired, never placed in one paired MuData training object, and never used to derive query labels
pairing_rules.gse289173: RNA-only sealed query; do not create an ATAC placeholder or a target latent from data
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; exact donor, sample, nucleus, ordered observation IDs, and one-to-one row alignment must pass before paired autoencoder or diffusion training

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, paired nuclei, generated draws, peaks, and seeds are not biological replicates.
rules.feature_and_scale_contract: Genes, peaks, raw-RNA and binary-ATAC recipes, layer-normalized architecture, RNA and ATAC latent standardizers, dimensions, diffusion schedule, clip rule, sampler, draw count, and output order are frozen inside outer-training donors.
rules.no_false_pairing: Released loaders silently index both modalities by row. Reject every unequal or reordered observation ID and all GSE244832 different-aliquot rows before tensor construction.
rules.profile_rule: Use only the Bernoulli ATAC decoder probability. No observed held ATAC depth, target size factor, query-fitted rescaling, or post hoc clipping may enter the prediction.
rules.query_isolation: Encode each held RNA row through frozen modules only. No Leiden, LabelEncoder.fit, class-conditioned label, query-batch moment, DPM-Solver branch, adaptation, or target assay may affect inference.
rules.stochastic_rule: Fresh immutable model_kwargs and a row-keyed prespecified random stream must make one cell's output invariant to query order, batching, addition, or removal.
